name: Osaka Castle
heritage: Important Cultural Property of Japan; Special Historic Site; Historic Site of Japan
text: Osaka Castle (Japanese: 大坂城 or 大阪城, Hepburn: Ōsaka-jō) is a Japanese castle in Chūō-ku, Osaka, Japan. The castle is one of Japan's most famous landmarks and played a major role in the unification of Japan during the sixteenth century of the Azuchi–Momoyama period.

credit.text: 国土地理院 (Institute of Land and Geography)

depictions.name: Osaka Castle
depictions.text: Osaka Castle (大坂城 or 大阪城) is a Japanese castle located in the city of Osaka, and one of Japan's most famous landmarks.
